name: directional-drawer_default
title: Directional Drawer Default
blurb: Left-side drawer preset with responsive mobile/desktop behavior.
description: A DirectionalDrawer variant pre-configured for left-side navigation with dismissible overlay on mobile; uses the directional-drawer component.
use_when: Quick left-side drawer without needing to customize the direction.
avoid_when: When you need to change direction — use directional-drawer with the direction prop instead.
a11y: Dismissible on mobile; full keyboard and touch support; backdrop click closes drawer.
